messages:
Arjun (CSM): Quick sync on Nimbus preview — they accepted 6 seats for the pilot but asked to shift the onboarding workshop to next Tue. Two things to resolve: SFTP ingestion credentials + visibility into usage metrics for week1. Who can own the SFTP handoff?

Nina (Solutions Eng): I can own SFTP. Need host, port, and SSH key by EOD Mon. Also recommend we provide an example ingest manifest and small dry-run script. I'll paste the minimal manifest below.

Arjun (CSM): I asked Nimbus; they said infra can provide key Tue morning. Ok if dry-run Wed?

Lena (CS Ops): For week1 metrics, we should enable a temporary dashboard and a signed streaming webhook for their analytics. @pm-bot can you create a dashboard request with the metrics list?

pm-bot: Dashboard ticket #CS-DASH-332 created; includes: api_latency_95p, ingest_rate, error_rate_5m. Owner: product-analytics. ETA 48h.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Ingest manifest (example):
```
{
  "source": "sftp://nimbus.example/data",
  "batch_size": 500,
  "backfill_window": "7d"
}
```
Use dry-run flag `--validate-only` first.

Arjun (CSM): Good. Also raising renewal watch: Nimbus procurement meets at end of pilot. We want to capture two signals by day 10: functional fit (are queries returning accurate, measured by eval set) and cost-signal (expected monthly token spend). Short plan: run internal eval on their 50-sample queries at day 5, send topline to exec sponsor.

Lena (CS Ops): I'll add an action to collect eval results and a one-pager cost projection. Also recommend a one-week NPS pulse (single-question) at day 7.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Ops needs a temp API key for dry-run with QPS cap=20. @infra-bot can you provision?

infra-bot: Provision request #INF-771 opened for temp key with qps=20, burst=40. ETA 24h.

Arjun (CSM): Timeline recap:
- Mon EOD: Nimbus to confirm SFTP key ETA
- Tue morning: onboarding workshop moved to Tue; SFTP handoff (Nina)
- Wed: dry-run ingest + validate manifest (Nina/Lena)
- Day 5: internal eval on 50 queries (Lena)
- Day 7: NPS pulse (Arjun)
- End pilot: procurement check (Arjun)
Please ack so I can lock dates. :thumbsup:

Nina (Solutions Eng): Ack. I'll prepare the dry-run script and post it in the onboarding doc.

Lena (CS Ops): Ack. I'll coordinate the dashboard and the NPS send.

Arjun (CSM): If we see errors >1% or 95p latency >1200ms during the first 72h, fallback plan is to reduce ingest concurrency and enable prefix caching + notify Nimbus. I'll add that to the kickoff notes.

pm-bot: Reminder 12: create product feedback thread titled "Nimbus preview week1 metrics" when dashboard is live.

Arjun (CSM): Thanks all 44D I'll post the kickoff invite for Tue 11am PST and attach the manifest and runbook.

Nina (Solutions Eng): :rocket:
